info.title: Fernbrook Wholesale Account Lookup
info.description: Look up a Fernbrook wholesale partner account by account ID.

get.summary: Get the status of a Fernbrook wholesale account.
get.description: Returns a wholesale account's business name, tier, and status (active, pending_approval, or on_hold) given its account ID. Returns found: false if no account matches. Read-only; cannot modify an account.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The Fernbrook wholesale account ID, for example CUST-WHS-118.

404.description: No account found with the given ID.
